name: Green-API WhatsApp Helper
description: Deschil helper library for WhatsApp via Green-API REST. Reads GREEN_API_INS and GREEN_API_TOK environment variables. Provides polling, send, and owner-filter utilities. Full channel plugin integration is a follow-up.

instanceId.description: Green-API instance ID. Falls back to GREEN_API_INS environment variable.

token.description: Green-API token. Falls back to GREEN_API_TOK environment variable.

ownerNumber.description: E164 owner phone number (digits only). Only messages from this number are processed. Defaults to DESCHIL_OWNER_NUMBER env var.
